verses.text: LORD, you are my God. I will lift you high and praise your name, for you have done wonderful things. You planned them long ago, and you have carried them out faithfully and truly.
You have turned the city into a heap of rubble, the strong city into a ruin. The palace of foreigners is no longer a city. It will never be rebuilt.
So strong peoples will honor you. Cities of cruel nations will respect you.

You have been a safe place for the poor, a safe place for the needy in their trouble, a shelter from the storm, and shade from the heat. For the breath of the cruel is like a storm beating against a wall.
Like heat in a dry land, you silence the noise of foreigners. Like heat cooled by the shade of a cloud, the song of the cruel is silenced.
On this mountain the LORD of Armies will prepare a feast for all peoples, a feast of the richest food and the finest wine, the best meat and the purest wine.
On this mountain he will destroy the covering that is over all peoples, the veil that is spread over all nations.
He will swallow up death forever! The Lord GOD will wipe away the tears from every face. He will take away the shame of his people from all the earth. The LORD has spoken.
On that day people will say, "Look, this is our God! We waited for him, and he saved us! This is the LORD! We waited for him. Let us be glad and celebrate because he has saved us!"
For the hand of the LORD will rest on this mountain. But Moab will be trampled down where it stands, like straw trampled into a manure pile.
Moab will stretch out its hands in it, like a swimmer stretching out their hands to swim. But God will bring down its pride, along with all the clever things its hands have done.
He will bring down your high, strong walls. He will tear them down and throw them to the ground, into the dust.
